meta.name: Members Only Palm Beach
meta.description:
Within the exclusive enclaves of Palm Beach County, follow a group of women navigating the unspoken rules, inherited traditions and high-stakes hierarchies of America's most rarefied social circles. In this manicured world of privilege and private clubs, reputations are built over brunch, alliances shift over champagne, and while wealth is ubiquitous, power, influence and access are the true currency.

Returning Series · First aired 29 Dec 2025 · United States of America · Language: English
Studio: Superluna Studios · Network: Netflix

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8

On your server — Audio: English

videos.title: Welcome To Palm Beach
videos.overview: Hilary hosts a party at her mansion and snubs a seasoned socialite. Rosalyn mentors newbie Ro-Mina, whose manners — and outfits — annoy the others.

videos.title: Will The Real Queen Please Stand Up?
videos.overview: A Palm Beach legend crowns Rosalyn at a high tea, while an overeager Ro-Mina gets a frosty reception from the other guests. Taja brokers a peace summit.

videos.title: How Do You Solve A Problem Like Maria?
videos.overview: Maria has a vulnerable moment at a pool party — made worse by Hilary's rebuke. Gale's constant name-dropping and one-upping wears thin.

videos.title: Boobs and Knees
videos.overview: Maria's DJ party is a bit too risqué for some of the women. Hilary revokes an invite to her wedding. Gale gets wind of Taja's snarky remarks.

videos.title: Fifth Time’s A Charm
videos.overview: Hilary's ceremony is overshadowed by a notable absence. Rosalyn and Gale take Ro-Mina shopping for conservative clothing to help her fit in.

videos.title: It’s My Party And I’ll Cry If I Want To
videos.overview: Hilary attends Maria's fundraiser, but makes it clear she's only there for Coco. The women are insulted by Ro-Mina's birthday party wishes.

videos.title: Allergic To Phony
videos.overview: Ro-Mina visits an etiquette expert and the lesson gets out of hand. Rosalyn sticks up for Gale's legitimacy when she's called a fraud.

videos.title: Game Of Crowns
videos.overview: Taja's celebration sours when she gathers the women and calls them out on their vicious gossip. Rosalyn and Hilary try to bury the hatchet.
